name: Vincent Gilmour
original_name: ヴィンセント・ギルモア
source:
Vincent is an English gentleman with a dignified appearance, and a university professor who researches and teaches European medieval history. Through his research he has been associated with the Leroy family since two generations ago. He's an occult maniac, and when it comes to things like ghosts and curses, he behaves like a completely different person.
